Name: AliveNpcs Shop Succession
Author: GarciaLuan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
AliveNpcs brings the villagers of Pelican Town to life with AI: they talk, gossip, and live out emergent story arcs. But when one of those arcs ends with a shopkeeper walking away from their store, the shop itself never changes. The counter stays frozen on the old owner, and the story and the world stop matching.

This mod closes that gap. It listens to every AliveNpcs arc that resolves. When an arc touches a shop owner, an AI reads the outcome and decides what really happened: the owner handed the shop over, the original owner came back, or nothing changed. If someone new is taking over, the mod makes it real in the game world.

The successor actually runs the shop. They walk to the counter at opening time, stand behind it through business hours, and sell the same goods the shop always sold. The old owner steps aside and goes about a normal day. The shop's greeting line and portrait switch to the new villager, so talking to the counter feels right. And the mod tells AliveNpcs the new owner is now canon, so the AI keeps the story straight from then on.

You are not limited to one kind of story. However you convince an owner to give up their shop, through gossip, through an arc, through being run out of town, the mod reacts to the result, not to a fixed script. You can even seed the rumor yourself and let the village talk its way to a new owner.

Six vanilla shops are covered: the Blacksmith, the Animal Shop, the General Store, the Saloon, the Fish Shop, and the Clinic. The Carpenter's shop is deliberately left untouched, because the house-upgrade system depends on Robin and handing her counter to someone else would break it.

Everything works in co-op. The host owns the story, and every other player sees the same shopkeepers behind the same counters.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI (4.0 or newer)[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43475]AliveNpcs[/url]. This mod does nothing without it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50946]AliveNpcs Multiplayer[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Put the AliveNpcsShopSuccession folder inside your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Multiplayer: every player must have the same version of this mod and of AliveNpcs. The host's shop changes are sent to everyone else automatically.

Updating: delete the old AliveNpcsShopSuccession folder first, then drop in the new one. Your config.json is kept.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Real shop takeover: a new villager walks to the counter, opens the shop, and sells the usual goods.
- AI-driven: an AI reads each resolved arc and decides if the owner left, came back, or nothing changed.
- Any path works: retirement, gossip, being run out of town, any way an owner gives up the shop.
- Old owner steps aside: the former owner leaves the counter during work hours and keeps a normal day.
- Matching look and feel: the shop's greeting and portrait switch to the new owner.
- Canon-aware: tells AliveNpcs the new owner is official, so the AI keeps the story consistent.
- Seed it yourself: plant the rumor and let the village talk its way to a new owner.
- 6 vanilla shops: Blacksmith, Animal Shop, General Store, Saloon, Fish Shop, Clinic.
- Co-op ready: the host's changes sync to every player.
- Safe by design: the Carpenter is left out so house upgrades never break.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

This mod is only possible because of the living, AI-driven villagers he built, and because he kindly gave permission to publish this bridge for it. All the story, gossip, and arc systems this mod reacts to are his work. Go check out AliveNpcs and show it some love. [/color]

Manifest.Description: When an AliveNpcs story arc hands a vacant shop to a new villager, this bridge makes it real: it moves the successor to the counter, opens the shop for them, and tells AliveNpcs the new owner is canon.
